caveats.sentence: Company fundamentals (earnings, margins, ratios) are today's figures from Finnhub, not the figures known on each past decision day.
Companies are found with today's symbol directory, so a company that was delisted or renamed since a decision day cannot be found.
Returns are price returns with no dividends, for the stocks and for the benchmark alike.
Every purchase fills at the next regular open of the stored daily bars, with no slippage and no commission.
Exits are judged on daily bars: a day that touches both the stop and the target counts as the stop, and on the day of the entry only the stop can fire.
There are fewer outcomes than the minimum sample, so every rate and average is a first look, not a verdict.
A position that no rule has closed is open: it is marked at the last stored close and is never counted as a win.
The models know the world only up to their own training cutoff, which can be later than a past decision day: they may remember what happened next.
